view_mode.label: Default view layout
view_mode.description: Choose between a compact tabular view or card layout.

hide_missing_runtimes.label: Hide missing runtimes
hide_missing_runtimes.description: Hide Docker or Podman when not installed on this machine.

label_format.label: Bar counter format
label_format.description: How the counter is formatted on the status bar.

show_label.label: Show counter on the bar
show_label.description: Display the number of services next to the icon.

hide_when_empty.label: Hide when nothing is running
hide_when_empty.description: Hide the bar widget when no container and no host service is listed.

show_stopped.label: Include stopped containers
show_stopped.description: Query every container instead of only the running ones.

show_host_services.label: Include host services
show_host_services.description: Also list the services running directly on this machine that listen on a TCP port.

open_host.label: Host used for links
open_host.description: Hostname used to build the URL when a port is published on every interface. Ports published on a specific address keep that address.

command_prefix.label: Command prefix
command_prefix.description: Optional prefix in front of every lookup command, for example "sudo -n". Leave empty to run them as your own user. It also lets ss see the ports of other users, and systemd-resolved or cups.

browser_command.label: Browser command
browser_command.description: Optional browser command used to open a service. Leave empty to use xdg-open, your default browser.

panel.title: Containers

loading.title: Looking for containers…
loading.hint: The service is still polling docker and podman.

panel.hint: Click a service or port to open in browser · Right-click to copy URL

empty.title: No containers
empty.body: Publish a port (docker run -p 8080:80) and it shows up here.
